== Biography ==
Jane was born in 1804. She is the daughter of [[Robertson-30564|Robert Robertson]] and [[Glasgow-2874|Anne Glasgow]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Father assessment — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Robertson-30564|Robert Robertson, later Glasgow]] is assessed 78% probable. Robert’s captured compiled account names a daughter Philadelphia Jane; the copied 1841 household places Jane Robertson, aged 20, with Robert and the same family. The compatible name and specific family setting support identification of this profile with that daughter, while leaving the full identity provisional. The compiled family account and copied household are not independent original proof. The original census and a full-name record have not been inspected. The inherited 1804 France birth fields conflict with age 20 if literal; neither is verified. This is the first numerical rating of a retained unmarked father, not a new attachment or discovery.

The earlier narrative and copied household text below are preserved as historical profile material; their unverified birth dates and relationships do not supersede this assessment. No new mother or vital-field conclusion follows from this father review.

Next test: Locate the original census and a record identifying Philadelphia Jane by full name, later surname or explicit father.

The household text is a quotation in the existing profile, not an inspected census schedule.<ref>[https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3022 Captured public WikiTree biography of Glasgow-3022, household source paragraph, reviewed 24 October 2026]; underlying census uninspected.</ref>

The surname change and compiled child list are cited in Robert’s captured account; the will, marriage and other archival citations in that account were not independently inspected in this review.<ref>[https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Robertson-30564 Captured public WikiTree biography of Robert Robertson, later Glasgow], citing T71/892, T71/1266 and SC6/44/4/1, reviewed 24 October 2026. This is a compiled account.</ref>


== Sources ==
<references />
* In 1841, Robert Glasgow, age 65, of independent means, born in Scotland, was living at Holly Walk, Leamington Priors, with Ann Glasgow age 40, Mary Glasgow age 19, Ann Robertson age 18, Jane Robertson age 20, Charlotte Robertson age 10 and Wilhelmina Robertson age 1, one male servant and four female servants. All the children were listed as being born in Scotland. Wilhelmina was the daughter of Robert Glasgow's eldest son, also Robert. The baptism of Charlotte in Edinburgh on 20/07/1828 gives her birth as Rome, 22/11/1827. Anne Glasgow the elder has not been traced and had presumably died by 1841. Anne Glasgow or Robertson the younger was born in Edinburgh 05/10/1805 and baptised 26/03/1805 in Ayton, Berwickshire. It is this younger Anne, the daughter, not the wife of Robert, who appears in the 1841 census.
